questions.question: When doing an offset back/left parking maneuver, what should a driver do?

options.text: Move forward straight, then back up to the left.
Back up straight, then move forward to the left.
Move forward straight, then back up straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move forward straight, then back up to the left.
questions.explanation: For an offset back/left parking maneuver, move forward straight first, then back up to the left. Your vehicle must stay completely within the parking space lines.

questions.question: What does a driver need to transport hazardous materials?

options.text: A CDL with a hazardous materials endorsement
A CDL with a tank endorsement
A CDL with a cargo endorsement

questions.correctAnswerText: A CDL with a hazardous materials endorsement
questions.explanation: You need a CDL with a hazardous materials endorsement to drive any vehicle carrying hazardous materials.

questions.question: What must be in a vehicle transporting chlorine?
questions.explanation: Drivers transporting chlorine in cargo tanks must have an approved gas mask in the vehicle.

questions.question: How must hazardous materials containers be prepared?

options.text: Secured to prevent movement during transport.

questions.correctAnswerText: Secured to prevent movement during transport.
questions.explanation: Hazardous materials containers must be secured so they will not fall, slide, or bounce during transport.

questions.question: Where should your vehicle be at the end of a basic vehicle controls test exercise?

options.text: In the general area the examiner described.
In the exact position the examiner described.
Within three feet of the position the examiner described.

questions.correctAnswerText: In the exact position the examiner described.
questions.explanation: You must finish each exercise with your vehicle in the exact position the examiner described. Not doing this can result in failing the basic control skills test.

questions.question: How must you complete a Uniform Hazardous Waste Manifest?

options.text: Sign it only if you cross into another state.

questions.explanation: When transporting hazardous waste, you must carry a Uniform Hazardous Waste Manifest and sign it by hand.

questions.question: How often must hazardous materials employees be trained and tested?
questions.explanation: All drivers must receive training on hazardous materials security risks and how to recognize threats. Hazardous materials employees must be trained and tested at least once every three years.

questions.question: How should a driver exit their vehicle during a test?

options.text: Jump directly from the seat to the ground.
Keep at least one hand on the vehicle at all times.

questions.explanation: When exiting your vehicle during the basic vehicle control skills test, face the vehicle and keep three points of contact at all times. For buses, hold the handrail. Exiting incorrectly may result in automatic failure.

questions.question: When making a turn during your driving test, what should you do?

options.text: Use your turn signal only if other cars are nearby.
Check traffic only in the direction you are turning.

questions.explanation: When turning during an on-road driving test, check traffic in all directions and use your turn signal.

questions.question: What should you check about your vehicle's pedals before a trip?

options.text: The grooved pedal surface is not smooth.

questions.correctAnswerText: The grooved pedal surface is not smooth.
questions.explanation: Check that nothing blocks the pedals and they work properly. Make sure the pedal surfaces are grooved and not smooth for better grip.

questions.question: When exiting a vehicle, you must always maintain ____ with your vehicle.
questions.explanation: During the basic vehicle control skills test, face the vehicle and keep three points of contact at all times as you exit. If you are driving a bus, hold the handrail. Exiting incorrectly will result in automatic failure of the test.

questions.question: You may leave a vehicle carrying explosives unattended only:

options.text: On the shoulder of a highway.

questions.explanation: When transporting hazardous materials, you may only leave your vehicle unattended in a safe haven. A safe haven is an approved location for parking vehicles loaded with explosives.

questions.question: If hazardous materials cargo catches fire, you should:

options.text: Try to put out the fire with a fire extinguisher.
Call emergency personnel and let them handle the fire.
Continue driving to the fire department.

questions.correctAnswerText: Call emergency personnel and let them handle the fire.
questions.explanation: Hazardous materials fires need special training and equipment to fight. Unless you have this training, let emergency personnel handle the fire.

questions.question: When you apply for a new or renewed HazMat endorsement, which agency performs the background check?
questions.explanation: The Transportation Security Administration (TSA) conducts a federal security threat assessment for all new and renewed HazMat endorsement applications.

questions.question: Who is responsible for marking and labeling materials for shipping?
questions.explanation: The shipper is responsible for correctly labeling and marking hazardous materials. The driver should verify that the shipper properly labeled and marked the materials before starting the trip.

questions.question: For a driver's side parallel parking maneuver, you should:

options.text: Pull directly forward into the parking space.
Back up past the space, then pull forward into it.
Pull forward past the space, then back into it.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull forward past the space, then back into it.
questions.explanation: For a parallel parking space on your left, drive past it first. Then back up into the space, keeping the rear of your vehicle close to the rear of the space. Your vehicle must stay completely within the space boundaries.

questions.question: An encroachment occurs when:

options.text: A driver does not show up for their basic skills test.
A vehicle touches a boundary line during the basic skills test.
A driver fails one section of the basic skills test.

questions.correctAnswerText: A vehicle touches a boundary line during the basic skills test.
questions.explanation: An encroachment happens when any part of your vehicle touches or crosses a boundary line during the basic vehicle control skills test. Each encroachment counts as an error.

questions.question: When you approach a railroad crossing while carrying chlorine, you must:

options.text: Slow down before crossing the tracks.
Cross without stopping if no warning lights are flashing.

questions.explanation: When transporting any amount of chlorine, you must always stop at a railroad crossing. Stop 15 to 50 feet from the nearest track, even if you do not see a train.

questions.question: A person attending a placarded vehicle may be:

options.text: Either awake or asleep inside the vehicle.

questions.explanation: An attendant at a parked placarded vehicle must be either awake inside the vehicle or within 100 feet of it with a clear view. The attendant cannot be in the sleeper berth.

questions.question: Shipping papers for hazardous materials must include:

options.text: The location of fire departments along the route.

questions.explanation: Hazardous materials shipping papers must include an emergency response telephone number.

questions.question: What shape are hazardous materials placards usually?
questions.explanation: Vehicles carrying hazardous materials must display diamond-shaped warning signs on all four sides. These signs are called placards.

questions.question: When can you move a vehicle that is not properly placarded?

options.text: To make room for other vehicles.
If the vehicle will travel fewer than 10 miles.

questions.explanation: A vehicle that is not properly placarded can only be driven if it is needed to protect lives or property during an emergency.

questions.question: What shape is a hazardous materials placard?
questions.explanation: Hazardous materials warning placards are diamond-shaped.

questions.question: How must a hazardous waste manifest be signed?

options.text: On the outside of the trailer.

questions.explanation: When transporting hazardous waste, you must carry a Uniform Hazardous Waste Manifest. It must be signed by hand.

questions.question: What is the minimum fire extinguisher rating for a placarded vehicle?
questions.explanation: A placarded vehicle must have a fire extinguisher with an Underwriters Laboratories (UL) rating of at least 10 B:C.

questions.question: Shippers package hazardous materials to ____ them.
questions.explanation: Shippers package hazardous materials to keep them fully contained. Vehicles display placards to show what cargo they carry.

questions.question: What will the examiner score you on during the driving test?

options.text: How quickly you arrive at your destination.

questions.explanation: The examiner will score you on your driving maneuvers and general driving behavior. You must drive safely, obey all traffic signs and signals, follow the law, and avoid accidents and moving violations.

questions.question: How far must you park from buildings when carrying Division 1.1 explosives?
questions.explanation: When carrying Division 1.1, 1.2, or 1.3 explosives, you must park at least 300 feet from buildings, bridges, and tunnels. You can park closer only for short stops needed to refuel or handle other necessary tasks.

questions.question: What shape are hazardous materials placards?
questions.explanation: Hazardous materials warning placards are diamond-shaped.

questions.question: What should you NOT use when loading hazardous materials containers?
questions.explanation: Protect hazardous materials containers. Never use equipment that could damage containers, such as hooks.
